```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(rnaturalearth) #add lake erie in

# Load in shapefile of just rivers in ohio
oh_rivers_all <- sf::read_sf("./OH_Rivers.shp")
#huc of Maumee from dashboard
maumee_huc6 <- sf::read_sf("./Maumee_6HUC_Dissolve.shp")

#check crs of both
st_crs(oh_rivers_all)
st_crs(maumee_huc6)

#transform this shapefile to NAD83 17N
oh_rivers_all <- st_transform(oh_rivers_all, st_crs(maumee_huc6))

#cut the rivers to just NW ohio
nw_ohio_rivers <- sf::st_intersection(oh_rivers_all, maumee_huc6)

#quick plot
plot(nw_ohio_rivers)

# create basic map of ohio
ohio <- map_data("state", region = c("ohio"), exact=TRUE, interior = FALSE)

#plot to see if the rivers are there
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = maumee_huc6,
               fill = alpha("gray90", 0.9),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_sf(data=nw_ohio_rivers, fill="blue")
```
